title: Central Subway: progress slowed year by year in the federal profiles
question: How fast was the Central Subway being built, by the federal transit agency's own yearly profiles?
finding: The profiles put the project at 31% complete in January 2015, 53% in December 2015, 64% in December 2016 and 69% in December 2017: gains of 22, 11 and 5 points a year. Every profile repeats the 2012 grant agreement's $1.58 billion cost; the December 2016 one first says opening is a year past December 2018. Congress had appropriated $919.2 million of the federal share by then.
how: Percent complete, appropriations to date, the grant-agreement cost and any schedule warning read from the fiscal 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019 Capital Investment Grant profiles.
limits: Percent complete on a tunnel project is uneven: tunnelling finishes early and station fit-out is slow, so a falling yearly gain is partly normal. The profiles never revise the cost; the later $1.93 billion estimate is in the oversight screen. Contract disputes and change orders are in the construction case.
